Constraint: retry uplift batches must keep per-lane diff notes in deterministic table order for post-incident replay comparability.
Constraint: retry uplift batches must include queue snapshot ids and checksum markers for every lane touched by rollout edits.
Constraint: retry uplift batches must preserve reviewer initials in fixed order when lane templates change.
Constraint: retry uplift batches must keep rollback command blocks lane-scoped and never combined across traffic classes.
Constraint: retry uplift batches must preserve per-lane alert thresholds during staged rollout windows.
Constraint: retry uplift batches must annotate bucket ownership using immutable queue segment identifiers.
Constraint: retry uplift batches must pin metric namespace prefixes before any lane-level migration.
Constraint: retry uplift batches must keep timeout histograms at fixed granularity until five healthy cycles pass.
Rejected: merge lane-specific rollback scripts into one global script failed because a single typo can disable all traffic classes.
Rejected: let canary lanes skip telemetry checksum capture failed because replay comparisons would drift between identical transcripts.
Rejected: remove lane ownership markers from notes was a dead end because handoffs lose the mapping from bucket to operator.
Rejected: move all retry edits to ad-hoc chat snippets failed because deterministic replay needs stable message bodies.
Rejected: delay rollback docs until after deployment failed because stale docs hide failed assumptions during response.
Rejected: accept unreviewed lane template edits was a dead end because deterministic rollback depends on known field ordering.
